candidate_summary.limits: Isolated masks/receivers and deterministic animated attitude; not physics, pilot or whole-flight FPS. GPU timestamp polls may be delayed; wall samples include frame dispatch and receiver rendering. Gear/flaps are set before each bind; no dynamic articulation claim. Cache controls are sampled context, not a global simplification-error bound. Percentiles use linear interpolation; GPU samples may repeat or lag.
